mentions.name: AutoPTT
mentions.description: AutoPTT is getting a redesigned UI styled similar to Discord's settings, built with a pure C UI library (Nuklear) instead of Electron to keep resource usage low; gamers make up a large portion of its user base.
mentions.problem: Avoiding the bloat and high resource usage of Electron-based UIs while keeping the app lightweight.
mentions.audience: Gamers are a large portion of the user base
mentions.source_excerpt: I'm working on better UI for my app AutoPTT [1]. It's probably going to look somewhat similar to Discord's settings, except I won't be using Electron.
mentions.author: veyh
